gold: Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) with Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS)

selector.rationale: Nasopharyngeal swab positive by reverse transcriptase–polymerase chain reaction and symptoms such as fever, anosmia, and shortness of breath are highly suggestive of COVID-19

rejected.label: Community-acquired pneumonia
rejected.why: While symptoms and lab results could suggest community-acquired pneumonia, the specific diagnosis of COVID-19 is more precise given the positive PCR test

rejected.label: Obstructive sleep apnea-related hypoxemia
rejected.why: Although the patient has obstructive sleep apnea, the current presentation is more indicative of an acute infectious process rather than a complication of sleep apnea

rejected.label: Obstructive Sleep Apnea-Related Hypoxia
rejected.why: Similar to obstructive sleep apnea-related hypoxemia, the current symptoms and findings are more aligned with an acute infection like COVID-19
